ei.title: Chapter 4-12 2번: Market Power vs. Resource Depletion
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.

questions.passage: Forecasters who (A)[predict / prevent] resource depletion often (B)[embrace / ignore] or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to (C)[estimate / guarantee] how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 자원 고갈을 예측하는(predict) 전문가들은 시장의 힘을 무시하고(ignore), 매장량 지수를 사용해 추정한다(estimate).
det.analysis:
❌ ① prevent — ignore — estimate (A 반대: 예측→방지)
❌ ② predict — embrace — estimate (B 반대: 무시→수용)
❌ ③ predict — ignore — guarantee (C 반대: 추정→보증)
✅ ④ predict — ignore — estimate — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or (A)[underestimate / overestimate] the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will (B)[decrease / increase] each year, thus (C)[depleting / accumulating] resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 시장의 힘을 과소평가하고(underestimate), 수요가 증가할(increase) 것으로 가정하여 자원을 고갈시킨다(depleting).
det.analysis:
✅ ① underestimate — increase — depleting — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② overestimate — increase — depleting (A 반대: 과소평가→과대평가)
❌ ③ underestimate — decrease — depleting (B 반대: 증가→감소)
❌ ④ underestimate — increase — accumulating (C 반대: 고갈→축적)

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current (A)[reserve / surplus] index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further (B)[verify / assume] that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are (C)[forbidden / allowed] to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 현재 알려진 매장량(reserve) 지수를 사용하고, 수요 증가를 가정하며(assume), 시장이 역할을 하도록 허용되면(allowed) 자원은 더 오래간다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① reserve — verify — allowed (B 반대: 가정→검증)
❌ ② surplus — assume — allowed (A 반대: 매장량→잉여)
❌ ③ reserve — assume — forbidden (C 반대: 허용→금지)
✅ ④ reserve — assume — allowed — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Forecasters who ①<u>predict</u> resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to ②<u>estimate</u> how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index ③<u>conceals</u> that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that ④<u>demand</u> will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '숨기다(conceals)'가 아니라 '나타내다(indicates)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 지수가 기름이 고갈될 것임을 나타낸다.
det.analysis:
① predict — 예측하다, 원문 일치
② estimate — 추정하다, 원문 일치
③ conceals — 원문은 indicates(나타내다) ←정답
④ demand — 수요, 원문 일치

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ①<u>appreciate</u> or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current ②<u>reserve</u> index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount ③<u>currently</u> used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even ④<u>faster</u>. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '높이 평가하다(appreciate)'가 아니라 '무시하다(ignore)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 전문가들이 시장의 힘을 무시한다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
① appreciate — 원문은 ignore(무시하다) ←정답
② reserve — 매장량, 원문 일치
③ currently — 현재, 원문 일치
④ faster — 더 빠르게, 원문 일치

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource ①<u>depletion</u> often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index ②<u>multiplies</u> the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further ③<u>assume</u> that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they ④<u>fail</u> to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '나누다(divides)'가 적절한데 'multiplies(곱하다)'로 바뀌면 의미가 반대가 된다.
det.analysis:
① depletion — 고갈, 원문 일치
② multiplies — 원문은 divides(나누다) ←정답
③ assume — 가정하다, 원문 일치
④ fail — ~하지 못하다, 원문 일치

Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, __________, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시장이 역할을 수행한다는 것, 즉 '고갈이 일어남에 따라 가격이 오른다'는 것이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① demand will decrease over time — 수요 감소 (본문은 오히려 수요 증가를 가정)
❌ ② new resources will be discovered — 새 자원 발견 (본문에 언급 없음)
✅ ③ prices rise as depletion occurs — 고갈 시 가격 상승 ←정답
❌ ④ governments will regulate markets — 정부 규제 (본문은 시장의 자율 기능을 강조)
det.tip: prices rise as depletion occurs = 고갈이 발생하면 가격이 오른다 (시장의 가격 조절 메커니즘)
